name: markets
description: Live stocks (yfinance; PSX live from the exchange, history as SYMBOL.KA), crypto, gold/silver and currency rates, plus a research desk: 5 years of prices, fundamentals, analyst targets and news, a backtest on the asset's own history and 3,000 simulated price paths -> BUY / BUY ON A DIP / WAIT / AVOID with buy price, stop-loss, two sell targets and how much to buy for the owner's capital (1.5% risk per trade, max 20% in one asset); 'how did your market calls do' checks past calls.
route: stock prices, shares, crypto, gold or silver rates, currency rates; research a stock or coin and decide whether to buy, how much, and when to sell
